const tiles=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-shot] [class*=tile], [data-shot] [class*=frame], [data-shot] [class*=cand]')].filter(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().width>40); let bad=[]; for(const t of tiles){ const kids=[...t.querySelectorAll('span,button,summary,label,b,em,small')].filter(e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width>2&&r.height>2&&(e.innerText||'').trim()&&getComputedStyle(e).visibility!=='hidden';}); for(let i=0;i<kids.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<kids.length;j++){ const a=kids[i],c=kids[j]; if(a.contains(c)||c.contains(a)) continue; const r1=a.getBoundingClientRect(), r2=c.getBoundingClientRect(); const ox=Math.min(r1.right,r2.right)-Math.max(r1.left,r2.left), oy=Math.min(r1.bottom,r2.bottom)-Math.max(r1.top,r2.top); if(ox>2&&oy>2) bad.push((a.innerText||'').trim().slice(0,8)+' × '+(c.innerText||'').trim().slice(0,8)); } } return {tiles:tiles.length, overlaps:[...new Set(bad)].length, sample:[...new Set(bad)].slice(0,6)};

const s=[...document.querySelectorAll('summary,button')].find(e=>/技术详情/.test(e.innerText)); if(!s) return 'none'; const b=s.getBoundingClientRect(); s.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const a=s.getBoundingClientRect(); return {dx:Math.round(a.x-b.x), dy:Math.round(a.y-b.y)};
